The Flappy Bird tap-to-fly mini game is ready!

**Game features:**

- 🟡 **Tap to fly**: Tap anywhere on the screen and the bird jumps up; release and it falls under gravity
- 🟢 **Green pipes**: Pipes generated at random heights keep coming in from the right, and you have to pass through the gaps
- 📊 **Live scoring**: Successfully passing a pair of pipes scores 1 point; the current score and best record are shown live at the top
- 💀 **Collision detection**: Hitting a pipe, the ground, or flying off the top all end the game
- 🔄 **Play again**: When the game ends, a dialog shows your score; tap "Play Again" to restart; there is also a replay button on the right side of the AppBar
- 🎨 **Solid color-block art**: The bird is a golden circle, the pipes are green rounded rectangles, and the ground is beige — a clean, crisp pixel style

**Technical notes:**
- Built on the `flame_game` engine + pixel physics world
- 60fps frame loop; gravity, velocity, and collisions are all computed every frame
- Pipes are dynamically spawned/despawned to manage memory
- No backend dependency, runs purely on the front end
